sql: WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY customer_id,m), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(m) first_m,MAX(m) last_m FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,m,last_m) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_m,last_m FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(m,'+1 month'),last_m FROM spine WHERE m<last_m), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.m,s.last_m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.m=n.m), closing AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM filled), previous AS (SELECT *,LAG(balance,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_balance FROM closing), latest AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prior_balance=0 THEN balance*100.0 ELSE (balance-prior_balance)*100.0/prior_balance END growth FROM previous WHERE m=last_m) SELECT m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(growth>5) above5,SUM(prior_balance=0) zero_prior,SUM(prior_balance<0) negative_prior,AVG(growth) avg_growth FROM latest GROUP BY m

WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY customer_id,m), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(m) first_m,MAX(m) last_m FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,m,last_m) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_m,last_m FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(m,'+1 month'),last_m FROM spine WHERE m<last_m), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.m,s.last_m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.m=n.m), closing AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM filled), previous AS (SELECT *,LAG(balance,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_balance FROM closing), latest AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prior_balance=0 THEN balance*100.0 ELSE (balance-prior_balance)*100.0/prior_balance END growth FROM previous WHERE m=last_m) SELECT customer_id,m,net,balance,prior_balance FROM previous WHERE customer_id IN(3,4,10) ORDER BY customer_id,m

WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY customer_id,m), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(m) first_m,MAX(m) last_m FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,m,last_m) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_m,last_m FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(m,'+1 month'),last_m FROM spine WHERE m<last_m), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.m,s.last_m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.m=n.m), closing AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM filled), previous AS (SELECT *,LAG(balance,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_balance FROM closing), latest AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prior_balance=0 THEN balance*100.0 ELSE (balance-prior_balance)*100.0/prior_balance END growth FROM previous WHERE m=last_m) SELECT 100.0*SUM(growth>5)/COUNT(*) percentage_customers FROM latest

WITH RECURSIVE modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'dw_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_negative' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_zero_month'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR mode='purchase_negative' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode<>'dw_only' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), spine AS (SELECT mo.mode,c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net,n.m IS NOT NULL active FROM modes mo CROSS JOIN customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON mo.mode=n.mode AND c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing,MAX(CASE WHEN active THEN m END) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id) last_m FROM spine), lagged AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_close,LAG(net,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_net FROM balance), phases AS (SELECT 'latest_customer' phase,* FROM lagged WHERE m=last_m UNION ALL SELECT 'global_april',* FROM lagged WHERE m=(SELECT MAX(m) FROM months)), metric AS (SELECT phase,mode,customer_id,'cumulative' kind,closing current,prior_close prev FROM phases UNION ALL SELECT phase,mode,customer_id,'monthly',net,prior_net FROM phases) SELECT phase,mode,kind,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/prev END>5) signed_over5,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/prev END>5)/COUNT(*) signed_pct,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5)/COUNT(*) abs_pct,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)/prev*100 END>5)/COUNT(*) integer_pct FROM metric GROUP BY phase,mode,kind ORDER BY phase,mode,kind

WITH nets AS (
  SELECT customer_id AS cid, substr(txn_date,1,7) AS m,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal')
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date,1,7)
), cum AS (
  SELECT cid, m, SUM(net) OVER (PARTITION BY cid ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS bal
  FROM nets
), rn AS (
  SELECT cid, m, bal, LAG(bal) OVER (PARTITION BY cid ORDER BY m) AS prev_bal,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cid ORDER BY m DESC) AS r
  FROM cum
), g AS (
  SELECT cid, bal, prev_bal,
         CASE WHEN prev_bal IS NULL OR prev_bal = 0 THEN bal*100.0 ELSE (bal-prev_bal)*100.0/prev_bal END AS gr
  FROM rn WHERE r = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN gr > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_customers_growth_over_5pct
FROM g

mode<>'dw_only' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions), months(m) AS (SELECT date(MIN(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<(SELECT date(MAX(txn_date),'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)), spine AS (SELECT mo.mode,c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.net,0) net,n.m IS NOT NULL active FROM modes mo CROSS JOIN customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN nets n ON mo.mode=n.mode AND c.customer_id=n.customer_id AND m.m=n.m), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing,MAX(CASE WHEN active THEN m END) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id) last_m FROM spine), lagged AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_close,LAG(net,1,0) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prior_net FROM balance), phases AS (SELECT 'latest_customer' phase,* FROM lagged WHERE m=last_m UNION ALL SELECT 'global_april',* FROM lagged WHERE m=(SELECT MAX(m) FROM months)), metric AS (SELECT phase,mode,customer_id,'cumulative' kind,closing current,prior_close prev FROM phases UNION ALL SELECT phase,mode,customer_id,'monthly',net,prior_net FROM phases) SELECT phase,mode,kind,COUNT(*) n,SUM(prev=0) zero_prior,SUM(prev<0) neg_prior,SUM(prev>0 AND (current-prev)*100.0/prev>5) positive_prior_pass,SUM(prev=0 AND current>0) zero_pass,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/current END>5)/COUNT(*) current_denom_pct,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (MAX(current,0)-MAX(prev,0))*100.0/NULLIF(MAX(prev,0),0) END>5)/COUNT(*) clipped_pct FROM metric GROUP BY phase,mode,kind

WITH modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'dw_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_negative'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode='purchase_negative' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing FROM nets), pairs AS (SELECT a.mode,a.m current_m,b.m prior_m,a.customer_id,a.closing current,b.closing prev FROM balances a JOIN balances b ON a.mode=b.mode AND a.customer_id=b.customer_id AND a.m>b.m) SELECT mode,current_m,prior_m,COUNT(*) pair_n,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/prev END>5) signed_n,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5) abs_n FROM pairs GROUP BY mode,current_m,prior_m ORDER BY mode,current_m,prior_m

WITH modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'dw_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_negative' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_zero_month'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' OR mode='purchase_negative' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode<>'dw_only' OR txn_type IN ('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), bal AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing FROM nets), lagged AS (SELECT *,LAG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) prev,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m DESC) r FROM bal) SELECT mode,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(prev IS NULL) null_prior,SUM(prev IS NULL AND closing>0) null_positive,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN closing*100.0 ELSE (closing-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5) abs_no_null_pass,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN closing*100.0 ELSE (closing-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5)/COUNT(*) abs_no_null_pct,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN closing*100.0 ELSE (closing-prev)*100.0/prev END>5) signed_no_null_pass FROM lagged WHERE r=1 GROUP BY mode
